scope: Six ordinary multibyte splitting and missing-command diagnostic cases through four shell aliases compare native GNU with the immutable Rboxc candidate. Includes valid Unicode delimiters, ASCII delimiters, empty/mixed IFS and borrowed or quoted command display names. Complete parent and child Valgrind summaries are required. Native findings remain baseline observations; this is focused ownership evidence, not full Bash acceptance.

results.name: bash:unicode-ifs
args: export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; IFS=é; v='aébéc'; set -- $v; printf '%s:<%s>\n' "$#" "$@"
